Borderline. The user only said the user receives the link by e-mail when the job finishes, not who triggers the e-mail. The document assigns that action to the worker: line 104 "O worker consome o job, escreve o arquivo no S3 enquanto o gera e, ao terminar, aciona o envio do e-mail." and line 122 "W->>E: Pede o envio do link assinado". The API confirmation at line 119, "A-->>U: Confirma que o pedido foi recebido", is also not stated by the user.
